children.game_version: Play as a 'Follow the Leader' game in a line.

seniors.counts: Maintain the same sequence but at a slower pace.
seniors.seated_version: Perform the foot taps and hops while seated, holding the shoulders of the person in front.
seniors.standing_version: Perform with support from a chair or partner, reducing the intensity of the hops.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Hands placed on the hips of the person in front.
movement_profile.footwork: Tap right foot twice, tap left foot twice, hop forward, hop backward, three hops forward.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Line or open circle moving around the floor.
movement_profile.levels_and_jumps: Includes small hops forward and backward.
movement_profile.partnering: Participants hold onto the hips of the person in front to maintain the line.
movement_profile.posture: Upright, holding the hips of the person in front.

signature_moves.description: A combination of foot taps and forward/backward hops.
signature_moves.name: The Hop Sequence

music_profile.sound_description: Big band swing style, characterized by a steady, danceable beat suitable for a conga-line formation.

basic_steps: Tap right foot twice on the floor.
Tap left foot twice on the floor.
teaching.formation: Line or open circle, holding the hips of the person in front.
teaching.level_notes: Beginner-friendly due to the repetitive, simple nature of the steps.
